[[The Lifegiver]] is a [[unique item]] dropped by [[Chineh Soaring Light]] in the [[Cliffs of Dohjok]].

== Stats ==
:[[Energy]] +8
:[[Holy damage]]: 8-12 (Requires 4 [[Smiting Prayers]])
:Halves skill recharge of spells (Chance: 20%)
:[[Energy]] +3 (while health is above 50%)
:[[Health]] +20

==Replica==
This non-maximum unique item cannot be replicated exactly. The most close replica may include:
* One of the following staves:
** [[Winged Staff]] from collector [[Hoanjo]]
** Winged Staff from weaponsmith [[Fahri]]
* [["Hale and Hearty"]] inscription with Energy +3
* [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Fortitude]] salvaged from Cruel Staff of Fortitude from collector [[Wain Hughes]]
However, it will have a requirement 5 Smiting Prayers (instead of 4) and halves skill recharge of spells with chance 10% (instead of 20%).


Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create a [[perfect]] technical version of this item with:
*One of the following staves:
**[[Destroyer Staff]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]]
**[[Imperial Staff]] from collector [[Shen Xi]]
**[[Tormented Staff]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*Perfect [[Hale]] [[Staff Head]] OR Perfect [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Fortitude]]
OR
*One of the following staves:
**[[Winged Staff]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], or [[Soros]]
**[[Asuran Staff]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
